meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 01 of 2022, adopting the tentative budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
votes.description: Adopts the tentative FY2022-23 Capital Projects Fund budget for the Local Building Authority, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Local Building Authority and convene as the Redevelopment Agency.
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the LBA portion of the meeting and begin the RDA portion.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 05 of 2022, adopting the tentative budget for the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
votes.description: Adopts the tentative FY2022-23 budget for the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Redevelopment Agency and convene as the City Council.
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the RDA portion of the meeting and begin the City Council portion.

votes.motion: Approve the Work Session Meeting Minutes of February 8, 2022; April 12, 2022 and April 19, 2022; as well as the Formal Meeting Minutes of October 5, 2021; March 22, 2022; April 5, 2022; and April 12, 2022.
votes.description: Approves multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes of the Salt Lake City Council.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Item G-1 (2023 Distracted Driving Prevention Program Grant) to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Police Department's grant application for distracted driving enforcement and refers it to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the rezone and master plan amendment at 1950 S West Temple and 1948 S West Temple; direct staff to work with the petitioner and City Attorney's Office to prepare an agreement limiting building height on the property to 35 feet.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed rezoning from RMF-35 to CG for properties at 1948-1950 S West Temple and defers action, directing staff to prepare a height-limiting agreement.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the rezone and master plan amendment at 1902 South 400 East.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed rezoning from R-1-5,000 to RMF-35 and master plan amendment at 1902 South 400 East and defers action.

votes.motion: Continue the Public Hearing to a future Council meeting on the Library Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on the proposed Library Fund budget amendment for FY2021-22 to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 20 of 2022 amending the FY 2021-22 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for specified items on the motion sheet.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts the FY2021-22 Budget Amendment No. 7, covering items such as open space acquisition, bridge rebuild, Leonardo flood repair, cybersecurity improvements, housing trust fund transfer to RDA, and other adjustments.

votes.motion: Defer action to a future date on the ordinance adopting the City's Twenty-Year Public Lands Master Plan, Reimagine Nature.
votes.description: Defers Council action on adopting the Reimagine Nature 20-year Public Lands Master Plan to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 21 of 2022, an amendment to rename the Housing and Neighborhood Development Division (HAND) as the Housing Stability Division.
votes.description: Renames the Housing and Neighborhood Development Division to the Housing Stability Division to better reflect its mission.

votes.motion: Appoint Jorge Chamorro as the Director of Public Services.
votes.description: Approves the Mayor's appointment of Jorge Chamorro as the Salt Lake City Public Services Department Director.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 11 of 2022, adopting the tentative budget for Salt Lake City, Utah, including the tentative budget of the Library Fund, for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
votes.description: Adopts the tentative FY2022-23 budget for Salt Lake City and the Library Fund as presented by the Mayor.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 22 of 2022, amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for specified Foothills Trailhead items on the motion sheet.
votes.description: Adopts FY2021-22 Budget Amendment No. 6 items related to five new Foothills Trailheads, including a $1.3 million state grant and rescoped parks impact fees, with conditions on construction pause and maintenance.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 23 of 2022, amending Salt Lake City Code Chapter 2.54 pertaining to the use of city-owned vehicles.
votes.description: Amends city code on employee use of city-owned motor vehicles, revising personal use allowances, expanding distance limits, and updating location monitoring and emergency allowances.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 12 of 2022 for the series 2022 bond parameters and recognize the date set for a public hearing on the bond issuance for May 17, 2022.
votes.description: Adopts a parameters resolution authorizing the issuance and sale of up to $360,000,000 in Public Utilities revenue bonds for water, sewer, and storm water capital improvements, and establishes the protest period.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda of May 3, 2022 except Item L6 (proposed appointment of PNUT board member Mr. Khudhair).
votes.description: Approves consent agenda items including grant holding account items and board appointments for Pook Carson, Shaleane Gee, and Frances Ngo, excluding the appointment of Wisam Khudhair to the PNUT Board.
